meta.name: reconcile
meta.description: 128 F-reconciliation (jav/reconcile.py): which bank statement line paid which incoming invoice, by code. The invoice types, the payment window, the signal thresholds, the payment kinds left to a person and when a statement counts as verified coverage. Decisions: DECISIONS 128 (exact amount and at least one signal first; card payments with an exchange rate later; never 'unpaid').

changelog.note: 128 K1: first version. Rules ported selectively from the legacy project's orchestrator/framework/payables.py 0.1.1 (10_AIFLOW_V4 HEAD 4256cba): the reason-coded exclusions, the signals and 'an equal amount alone is no candidate'. New: the exact-amount rule, the window's upper end, coverage by verified statements.
